_comment: Reference values for lammps-thermostat-audit. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-thermostat-audit:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022).
_calibration_note: Fixed run (thermostat ALL, dt=0.005, seed 2718) is deterministic: 5 oracle runs identical; avg_temp(steps>=2500)=1.19642 (target 1.2, tol 3%). L4: kinetic T from dumped velocities matches thermo to dump print precision (tol 1%); run-0 PE of the dumped final frame matches the log last line (tol 1e-3).
